welcome-text:
👋 Welcome to 21ID! 

This bot will help you issue your 21ID Card, join communities, and a lot more.

To do that you will need:
- your School 21 Platform nickname (login)
- access to your email, which you have used in Applicant

Whole process takes less than 3 minutes and is fully free - so use button below to start
welcome-in-group-text:
👋 Welcome to 21ID! 

This bot will help you issue your 21ID Card, join communities, and a lot more.

Whole process takes less than 3 minutes and is fully free.

🔒 But to keep your information private - please, continue in private messages -> @id_21bot
start-nickname-prompt:
Firstly, send your School 21 nickname in shortened format (only 8 symbols or less, not full Name and Surname of login)
ℹ️ For example:
daemonpr, kristana, lilliank

⚠️ We apologize for any delays due to ping with School 21 API and Email server - you may need to wait around 10 seconds to get an answer.
info-text:
🪪 21ID is an identification system for School 21 students, which helps to...

- Find peers' from yours and other campuses, and notify them via Telegram and email
- Using your School 21 account to sign in to external services)

❓ If you want to contribute or ask questions about development - please visit https://github.com/21id/bot

Made with ❤️ from SKD & TAS by daemonpr (@megaplov)
nickname-invalid:
Nickname above is invalid, please try to send it again (in shortened format): only latin symbols, length of 8 or less

⚠️ For example: daemonpr, kristana, lilliank
nickname-not-found:
I couldn't find you, {nickname}!

⚠️ Please, check that sent nickname is correct

Examples:
daemonpr, kristana, lilliank
nickname-db-typo:
⚠️ I've detected you as {nickname} from my database scan, but I can't find you on Platform.

Please, provide your School 21 nickname in shortened format (only 8 symbols or less, not full Name and Surname of login)
nickname-other-account-blocked:
⚠️ Dear user, {nickname} is registered under another Telegram account, but we couldn't reach them to send a migration OTP - they may have blocked the bot.

ℹ️ If that's not you, please - send your School 21 student nickname again
nickname-resume-migration:
⚠️ Dear user, {nickname} is registered under another Telegram account.

You already have an active migration code. Please enter it below, or request it via email.

ℹ️ If that's not you - please send your School 21 student nickname again
nickname-migration-otp-spoiler-msg:
⚠️ Someone is trying to migrate your 21ID account ({nickname}) to another Telegram account.

If that's you - here is your migration OTP code: <tg-spoiler>{otp}</tg-spoiler>

Share it only if you want to migrate your account. If that's not you - ignore this message.
nickname-otp-prompt:
⚠️ Dear user, {nickname} is registered under another Telegram account.

We've sent a migration OTP code to the original account as a spoiler message. Please enter it below to migrate the account to your current Telegram, or request it via email.

ℹ️ If that's not you - please send your School 21 student nickname again
nickname-otp-sent:
Thanks!
📩 Now you need to verify that you are indeed {nickname}

For that, I've sent you a one-time 6 digits code to your mail (to {email}, which will be forwarded to your Personal Email), which you need to send me in a message, or use a link inside message

⚠️ Please, check your spam folder, as email can land there.

If you want to change nickname - use button below
nickname-email-unreachable:
⚠️ Dear {nickname}, there was a problem with your OTP code - it can't reach your mailbox. We are very sorry for the inconvenience.

ℹ️ Try again by sending your nickname, and if you still can't get it - contact @megaplov
nickname-chat-denied:
⚠️ Dear {nickname}!

You're denied from joining '{chat_title}' based on chat join policy:
Intensive allowed: {intensive}
Core allowed: {core}

If you think that it's wrong denial - please, contact @megaplov

- - - - - 

🪪 But you are more than welcome to join 21ID - just without joining {chat_title}. For that, follow the instructions below
verification-invalid-format:
OTP Code above is invalid, please try to send it again: check that it's exactly 6 digits and nothing else (whitespaces and others).

⚠️ For example: daemonpr, kristana, lilliank
verification-exhausted:
Dear {nickname}, you've used all your attempts to enter OTP code.

🔄 You are required to restart your registration process and enter nickname again with /start
verification-exhausted-join-extra: ❌ Because you were joining a chat, your join request will be canceled, and you will need to send it again
verification-wrong-code: ❌ Sent OTP code ({code}) is invalid, please try again (you have {remaining} attempts left to enter the right OTP code)
verification-join-error:
⚠️ Got an error, while trying to accept your join request: {error}

Please, notify @megaplov if you haven't been accepted, and if you are - just ignore this message
verification-success:
👋 Welcome to 21ID, {nickname}!

🔽 Basic functionality that you may need is right below, which you can access in main menu with /start command

🪪 To find other peers, please use inline mode. Guide on how to use 21ID Bot inline search is here: t.me/ident21/9
join-invite-not-found:
❌ Dear user, your OTP is expired (already used) or doesn't exist. Please, try to get your link again from Invitation email

❓ If you have any questions or believe that it's a mistake - please contact @megaplov
join-invite-success:
👋 Welcome to 21ID, {nickname}!

🔽 Basic functionality that you may need is right below, which you can access in main menu with /start command

🪪 To find other peers, please use inline mode. Guide on how to use 21ID Bot inline search is here: t.me/ident21/9
migration-otp-expired:
⚠️ Migration OTP has expired or wasn't found.

ℹ️ Please - send your School 21 student nickname again to get a new code
migration-otp-wrong:
⚠️ Wrong OTP code. {remaining} attempt(s) left.

ℹ️ Please - try again
migration-otp-exhausted:
⚠️ No attempts left for migration OTP.

ℹ️ Please - start over and send your School 21 student nickname again to receive a new code
migration-otp-success:
Your 21ID account has been successfully migrated to your Telegram account!

You are now registered in 21ID. Welcome!
migration-otp-email-error: Could not send email. Please try again.
migration-otp-cancel: Please - send your School 21 student nickname
communities-text: List of all public communities, which are part of 21ID ecosystem
search-usage:
Usage:
/search daemonpr - by nickname
/search @username - by Telegram username
/search 182481972 - by Telegram user ID
Or reply to a message with /search
inline-awp-in: 🖥 {nickname} is currently logged in cluster {cluster} on {row}.{number}
inline-verified: ✅ Because he's registered in 21ID, you can try contacting him, using buttons below
inline-not-verified: ⚠️ This user isn't verified, but you can try contacting him, using buttons below
inline-unregistered-hint: 🪪 Register in 21ID to get more information about student!
inline-student-awp-in: 🖥 {nickname} is currently logged in cluster {cluster} on {row}.{number}
inline-student-can-invite:
❌ Because he isn't registered in 21ID, you can't contact him right away.

🪪 But you are more than welcome to invite him to 21ID by using the button below - we would send him a notification that you're looking for him
inline-student-unregistered: 🪪 Register in 21ID to get more information about student!
inline-not-found-full: Nickname '{nickname}' (even if it's partial) doesn't belong to any student or 21ID user
notify-self: You can't send notification to yourself, {nickname}!
notify-not-registered:
For privacy and security of our users, 21ID allows notification only for registered users

🪪 So you should register in 21ID first, it takes less than 3 minutes
notify-target-not-found:
You're trying to notify not found user!

Please try again from start
notify-no-telegram:
User has no Telegram ID

Please try again from start
notify-message:
🚨 IMPORTANT 🚨

Hey, {nickname}!
⚠️ {sender} ({wave}, {campus}) is looking forward to contacting with you (may be because of Peer Review). 
ℹ️ Please, contact ASAP him via Rocket.Chat, Telegram or check School 21 Platform (AKA Edu) for incoming Peer reviews

⚠️ If this user is spamming you with requests - we are sorry. Please contact @megaplov - he will try to resolve this issue
notify-success:
Successfully sent a notification to {nickname}!
⚠️He can see your nickname and contact info
notify-blocked: ⛔ {nickname} has blocked 21ID bot or deleted his telegram account, can't reach him!
account-migration-start:
⚠️ Account Migration

This will move your 21ID registration from your current account to a new Telegram account.

Use the button below to select the new account.
account-migration-self-error:
⚠️ You can't migrate your account to yourself.

Please select a different Telegram account.
account-migration-taken:
⚠️ This Telegram account is already registered in 21ID.

Please select a different account or contact @megaplov.
account-migration-confirm-1: Are you sure you want to migrate your account to this Telegram user?
account-migration-confirm-2: Are you 100% sure? This action cannot be undone.
account-migration-confirm-3: Last chance! You totally sure you want to do this?
account-migration-error: ⚠️ Something went wrong. Please try again.
account-migration-success:
Your account has been successfully migrated!

Please start the bot from your new Telegram account.
